branch: four-view (and five-view) Phi_0 phantom-nonempty census at tau approx 0, needed to support or retire the fifth-camera-does-real-work claim
what: Extends the existing 2-view/3-view Phi_0 census (option_a_frontier ck_2_3_phantoms1933) to 4-view (all C(5,4)=5 subsets) and 5-view (the full set), on both the 210-structure original evaluation sample and the 1950-structure e50 neighborhood-stable subset, at tau=1e-6 (approx 0).
headline: Phantom-nonempty rate reaches exactly 0.0% at four views on BOTH samples (0/1050 on n=210; 0/9750 on n=1950), matching the five-view rate (0/210; 0/1950). The three-view rate (1.9% both samples) is the last nonzero rate; the fifth camera adds no further reduction beyond what the fourth already achieves.
provenance: scripts/run_phantom_census_e3.py, scripts/run_phantom_census_e50.py; raw outputs raw_e3_census_all_subsets.json, raw_e50_census.json in this directory.
